Atlans Map Guide

Atlans is the underwater map between Noria and Tarkan and the level 50–90 hunting map on Global MU Online. It is split into three areas with their own warps: Atlans (level 50) in the north-west, Atlans 2 (level 80) in the north-east and Atlans 3 (level 90) in the centre, where the Great Bahamuts, Silver Valkyries and Lizard Kings live. 567 monsters stand on the map.

3D spot map · Warps & access · Monsters · Events · Drops · Tips · FAQ

Quick facts: Level 50 to warp (Atlans), 80 (Atlans 2), 90 (Atlans 3) · 4,000–5,000 Zen · 7 monsters Lv 43–74 · 567 monsters on the map · gates to Noria (50), Elbeland (10) and Tarkan (130) · Golden Lizard King and Golden Vepar invasions.

Warps & access — getting in and moving around

Three warps. Atlans (level 50, 4,000 Zen) lands in the north-west entrance hall at 15–27,11–23, right next to the Noria and Elbeland gates. Atlans 2 (level 80, 4,500 Zen) drops you at 225–228,50–53 in the north-east and Atlans 3 (level 90, 5,000 Zen) at 62–68,157–163 in the deep centre. On foot you enter from Noria (gate at Noria 242,240, level 50) or Elbeland (Elbeland 247,149, level 50), and you leave for Tarkan through the gate at 14–15,225–230 in the south-west (level 130).

Monsters in Atlans

The entrance area is Bahamuts, Vepars and Valkyries (level 43–46); the centre and east are Great Bahamuts and Silver Valkyries (188 on the map — the most common monster here) and the Lizard Kings at level 70. Hydra is the rare one: level 74, 38,000 HP and 500–620 damage, only nine on the map, all in the deep centre.

Events on this map

  • Golden Invasion — Golden Lizard King (×10), Golden Vepar (×10) spawn here during the invasion, anywhere in 50,50 – 200,200. Golden monsters drop Box of Kundun; full schedule and spawn maps on the Golden Invasion guide.
  • Blessing Box — the hourly WCoin box can land on this map; see the Blessing Box guide for the timer and rewards.

What drops here

Atlans is where the level 5–8 sets start dropping and the classic spot for Jewel of Life farming. The map bag holds 269 item types — 43 armor lines (Bronze, Bone, Scale, Sphinx, Brass, Silk, Wind, Spirit, Violent Wind, Robust…) plus weapons, shields and skill items such as Rapier, Katana, Sword of Assassin, Blade, Gladius, Falchion, Sword of Salamander, Light Saber… 899 of the 1870 bag entries are excellent versions. The full per-monster tables with rates are on the Atlans drop list.

Hunting tips

  • Atlans 3 (centre) is the best EXP on the map from level 80 to 130: Silver Valkyries and Great Bahamuts stand in dense packs around 60–120,150–190.
  • Lizard Kings have 18,000 HP and hit for 480–540 — keep a Large Healing Potion stack until you have level 6 gear.
  • Hydra spots are the nine markers in the middle; at 38,000 HP it takes a while at level 80 but drops the best gear on the map.
  • Golden Lizard Kings and Golden Vepars (x10 each) spawn in the 50–200 square during the Golden Invasion — Box of Kundun +3.
  • The Tarkan gate is far from every warp (south-west corner); use it only if you want to walk to Tarkan below level 130, since the Tarkan warp needs 130 anyway.

FAQ

What level do I need for Atlans?

Level 50 for the Atlans warp (4,000 Zen), 80 for Atlans 2 (4,500 Zen) and 90 for Atlans 3 (5,000 Zen). The gates from Noria and Elbeland need level 50.

Where is the Atlans entrance in Noria?

At Noria 242,240 in the far north-east corner (level 50). You arrive at Atlans 14-15,12-13.

Where does Hydra spawn in Atlans?

Nine Hydras stand in the deep centre of the map, in the Atlans 3 area. Their exact spots are the dark markers on the map above.

How do I get from Atlans to Tarkan?

Through the gate at 14-15,225-230 in the south-west corner (level 130), which lands you at Tarkan 248,40. The Tarkan warp costs 8,000 Zen and also needs level 130.

Can I fly in Atlans?

Wings and flying mounts work normally for stats, but the map is underwater so movement looks like swimming - there is no flying shortcut over the walls.

Next is Tarkan (level 130). Back to Noria or Elbeland.
